description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Martial Ka'tah readied state on the board (WP-C3). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active (P1 Custodes, round 2): loading the Command-phase save runs the readied step. (1) Every model of every Custodes unit with Martial Ka'tah carries the gold 'K' readied badge (TokenVisual.katah_readied_marker); the Ork models do not. (2) Hovering the Custodian Guard shows a 'Readied' line in the hover card. (3) The player ends the Command phase with real clicks: the new command_phase_main window opens with the 0-CP CONSERVAI card; a real click on 'Use on Custodian Guard Sodality' un-readies that unit — its badges disappear while the other units keep theirs — and its hover card now lists CONSERVAI instead of Readied. (4) The re-opened window (the other readied units) is declined and the phase moves on to Movement; Conservai is still active (until the end of the turn).

steps.comment: frame the front line (Custodian Guard B, Shield-Captain, Blade Champion vs the Boyz / Deff Dread)
steps.script:
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var focus := Vector2(560.0, 1220.0)
var z := 1.6
var vp: Vector2 = m.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
m.camera.position = focus
m.camera.zoom = Vector2(z, z)
m.view_zoom = z
m.view_offset = focus - vp / (2.0 * z)
m.update_view_transform()
return true

steps.comment: readied badge on every model of the 9 Martial Ka'tah units, on no Ork model

steps.script:
var t = tree.root.get_node("Main")._token_hover_label
return t != null and t.get_parsed_text().contains("Readied")

steps.comment: the Custodian Guard's badges are gone; the Shield-Captain keeps its badge
re-opened for the other readied units
